analyze_profiler_trace: analyze PyTorch profiler traces from a directory and generate a bandwidth and performance report
preprocess_profiler_trace: preprocess a single rank's profiler trace and save extracted bandwidth data to disk
summarize_profiler_trace: summarize preprocessed profiler trace data from all ranks and generate an analysis report
calculate_bw_: calculate algebraic and bus bandwidth for NCCL collective communication events in a trace
calculate_sbw: calculate shared bandwidth per rank from NCCL kernel events in a profiler trace
